Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference image for Bacterial_Stalk_Rot shows brown rotted stalk tissue but appears drier than the test image. The test image has a distinctly wet, slimy, dark brown rot concentrated at a node with visible liquid ooze — matching the description of "water-soaked, soft and mushy" tissue with potential foul odor characteristic of Bacterial_Stalk_Rot.

The symptom description aligns well: water-soaked lower internodes turning tan to brown, soft and mushy, plant collapse with vascular strands remaining intact, decay at nodes. The dark/wet appearance with surrounding yellowing leaves fits.
